name: AutoShortQR
description: Auto-generates a self-referencing QR code (and short link) for pages, using drupal/barcode.
project_description:
This modules adds autocomputed short url and QR code fields to nodes and terms.

 Installation 
 Install the module using composer: composer require drupal/autoshortqr 

Enable the module using drush: drush en autoshortqr 

 Dependencies 
 The module requires drupal/barcodes and tecnickcom/tc-lib-barcode . For tecnickcom/tc-lib-barcode, the general packagist repo may be necessary.

 Setup 
 Navigate to the content type ( /admin/structure/types/manage/TYPE ) or vocabulary ( /admin/structure/taxonomy/manage/TYPE ).

In the section Autocode, activate the desired functions.
